summary: Amass Brands filed an 8-K reporting the creation of Series C Convertible Preferred Stock via a Certificate of Designation. The series comprises 35,000 shares senior to all other equity, with a 2% quarterly preferred return (18% upon default), no common participation, and liquidation preference equal to stated value plus accrued return. Conversion is at a fixed price, adjustable to market price after a trigger event or default. This capital structure amendment is a standalone financing maneuver, not a change-of-control event, tender offer, restructuring, or special situation. The filing is a routine equity-class creation with no transaction, strategic review, activist involvement, or liquidation plan; thus it does not meet special-situation criteria.
